title: Meter Reading Customer Request Form
subtitle: An original meter reading workflow that preserves the customer's observation and routes a clear service response, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete meter reading customer request form for the utility meter and register that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a customer asks for service, investigation, or follow-up and staff need a traceable account of the requested outcome, symptoms, evidence, safety screen, communication, and disposition. The meter operations lead owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Meter reading customer request and communication routing
sections.guidance: Capture the customer's own observation and give the request a clear service owner.

sections.title: Meter reading requested outcome and customer constraints
sections.guidance: Describe the requested result without treating the customer's suspected cause as confirmed.

blocks.label: Customer request type
items: Routine or missed meter read
Move-in, move-out, or final bill read
High or unexpected usage review
Estimated reading correction
Meter or register identity question
Remote communication failure
Access appointment or location update
Leak, reverse flow, or equipment concern

blocks.label: Customer observation in their own words

fields.label: What was observed, when it began, frequency, affected service, desired outcome, and prior contact

sections.title: Meter reading condition timeline and supplied evidence
sections.guidance: Preserve dates, sources, and attachments so service staff can distinguish symptoms from verified findings.

blocks.label: Customer-supplied evidence
items: Photograph or video reference
Bill, usage, or account reference
Display, alarm, or fault wording
Prior ticket or service record
Site plan, equipment document, or product reference
Access instruction, property permission, or appointment detail
Critical-service or accessibility information
No supporting attachment; follow-up owner assigned

sections.title: Meter reading exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Gas odor, hissing, damaged regulator, or suspected leak
Exposed conductor, arcing, heat, burn mark, or damaged electric enclosure
Flooding, standing water, active leak, ice, or unstable walking surface
Aggressive animal, insect nest, traffic, excavation, or restricted access
Broken seal or enclosure requiring opening or equipment manipulation
Unknown meter identity, cross-connection, or unsafe customer equipment
Weather or site condition prevents a safe, reliable observation
Any work beyond a normal-interface read and assigned authorization
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: A reading record does not authorize opening, bypassing, adjusting, or repairing a meter or related service equipment. Stop for gas odor, exposed electrical parts, water near energized equipment, flooding, animals, traffic, or unsafe access. Withdraw, keep others clear, and route the condition to qualified utility or emergency personnel under current site procedures.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each customer request exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Meter reading decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Utility meter and register identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
